en.abdullah-al-shahin: (14) Abdul Wahid bin Abdullah bin Younus narrated from Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Rabah az-Zuhri from Ahmad bin Ali al-Himyari from al-Hasan bin Ayyoob from Abdul Kareem bin Amr from Muhammad bin al-Fudhayl that Hammad bin Abdul Kareem al-Jallab had said:
Once al-Qa’im (as) was mentioned before Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as). He said: “If he appears people will say: How can that be whereas his bones have been perished since so and so?”
